notes:
Account summary: Galewood RankShield builds a helpdesk + self-service layer used by several mid-market SaaS customers. Currently using a hybrid Elastic + custom ranking stack; exploring RAG approach to power an in-chat agent + a deflection-enabled KB search. Tight latency SLOs (target p95 <= 150ms for assistant answers, p95 <= 120ms for rerank+respond flow).

Key technical constraints and asks:
- Corpus scale: ~12M documents (tickets + KB + community posts), estimated 250GB raw text; expect ~1.1B tokens indexed; embedding index expected to be ~90-120GB depending on dimension.
- QPS: baseline 25 qps, peak 150 qps during support peaks; target steady-state tail latency for top-5 rerank retrieval under 200ms.
- Cost target: aim for < $0.01/query (end-to-end for embed + rerank + generative token cost) to be viable across customers. High sensitivity to per-query amplifier.
- Reranking: want a supervised reranker for top-5 quality with offline eval target of precision@5 >= 0.78 and NDCG@5 gain vs current system >= +12%.
- Model preferences: prefer open/quantized reranker + small instruction-tuned chat model for final response; want ability to route to larger generative model for escalations.
- Reliability: multi-region fallback (na->eu), ability to pin model versions, automatic fallback to compatible quantized variant when Dedicated capacity constrained.
- Security: dedicated VPC or on-prem for regulated customers; KMS integration mandatory; audit logs and 1y retention for security events. Data residency: EU for some customers.
